resolved_intents.intent: Perform valid login with username and password
Search for product and add to cart

missing_methods.intent: Locate profile name element in dashboard header
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Locate and return the profile name element in the dashboard header. This method should use a locator strategy to find the element containing the user's profile name displayed in the header section of the dashboard.

missing_methods.intent: Wait for profile name to be visible
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the profile name element in the dashboard header to become visible. This method should implement an explicit wait with a configurable timeout (default 10 seconds) to ensure the profile name element is displayed before proceeding. Should return True if visible within timeout, False otherwise.

missing_methods.intent: Assert profile name text equals expected value
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Verify that the profile name text displayed in the dashboard header matches the expected value. This method should retrieve the text from the profile name element and assert it equals the expected_name parameter. Should raise an assertion error with a descriptive message if the values do not match.
